purpose: Teach: 勝る/術後/検問/尊い/固有名詞/さなか/変ら/塵

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、研究、原作に勝るとも劣らない翻訳論、興味深く読みました。
lines.en: Ren, I found your research compelling — particularly the argument about the translation standing on equal footing with the original work.
lines.style: Warm, genuine approval. Steady pace. Leans forward slightly, making eye contact. A teacher speaking to a student she respects.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時の作家、術後の闘病記、参考になりました。
lines.en: Yes. The author's postwar recovery diary from that period was really helpful as a reference point.
lines.style: Quiet, careful. Speaking precisely because the subject matters. Slight hesitation before 'recovery' — choosing the right word. Respectful.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時の検問下で、書かれた手記、貴重な史料ですね。
lines.en: Those memoirs written under wartime censorship are genuinely precious historical documents.
lines.style: Slower, more measured. Soft reverence in the voice. Pausing slightly before 'precious' — the weight of the word settling in. Not performative.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。一人一人の人生が、尊いことを、痛感しました。
lines.en: Yes. I really came to feel how invaluable each individual life is, especially reading those words.
lines.style: Voice catches slightly on 'invaluable.' Not emotional, but present with the realization. Quiet, genuine conviction. Trailing off at the end — still sitting with what he's learned.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 固有名詞の使い方、論文全体で、統一されていますね。
lines.en: The way you handled proper nouns throughout the paper — there's real consistency there.
lines.style: Warm nod in the voice. Noticing small rigor. Not praise-heavy, but specific and genuine. A teacher seeing the student's care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦争のさなかでも、文学は生き続けました。
lines.en: Yes. Even in the midst of war, literature continued to live on.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering tone. Speaking as though discovering it again. Not grandiose — intimate. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 時代が変らずに、価値観が普遍的なテーマ、扱いましたね。
lines.en: You touched on a theme that transcends era — universal values that don't fade with time.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Measured, with genuine interest in what he's uncovered. Looking at the bigger picture with him. Steady breath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴史の塵に埋もれそうな声、拾い上げました。
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to recover the voices that were nearly buried by history's dust.
lines.style: Quiet resolve. Speaking with care and intention. The phrase 'buried by history's dust' lands with quiet weight — he's protecting something important here. Slight fadeout at the end.
